newsitem.title: USA: Comstock holders convert preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Comstock holders convert preferred shares.

text.p: Comstock Resources Inc said on Monday that the holders of all of the outstanding shares of its Series 1994 Convertible Preferred Stock converted their preferred shares into 1.5 million shares of common stock.
The company said in a statement that it paid quarterly dividends on the Series 1994 Convertible Preferred Stock at an annual rate of nine percent before the conversion, or about $540,000 a year.
This year Comstock converted all of the outstanding shares of the 1994 Series B Convertible Preferred Stock into two million shares of common stock.
Before this conversion on July 11, 1996, Comstock paid quarterly dividends on the 1994 Series B Convertible Preferred Stock at an annual rate of 6.25 percent, or about $625,000 per year.

As of September 16, Comstock's shareholders' equity consists of 17.26 million shares of common stock and 1.5 million shares of the Series 1995 Convertible Preferred Stock which are convertible into 2.86 million shares of common stock.
